Strategy: Refine the family with a small-leftover peak: score bins by closeness of the leftover to item/3, with a bonus for an exact fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest bin leaves less than item/3 while a looser bin lands near it, so a near-tight bin wins. A small gap may stay usable for tiny items, but chasing it can pass over tighter fits.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) - abs((r - item) - item / 3) for r in bins]
```
